subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 2: WOW! Team Talk – Online shopping
outcomes: Understand opinions in a dialogue about online shopping and shops.
Use No chance!, I'm only kidding! and That's true.
Write and act out a short shopping dialogue.

tf.s: Rosie and Manar both like online shopping.
tf.why: Rosie likes online shopping; Manar prefers shops.

tf.s: Manar invites Rosie to come shopping at the weekend.
tf.why: Yes, Manar invites her for the weekend.

tf.s: Rosie thinks shopping in shops is a waste of time.
tf.why: Correct, Rosie says it's a waste of time.

tf.s: Rosie sends things back if they don't fit.
Manar thinks we may not need shops in the future.
tf.why: It is Rosie who thinks that.
Yes, you say it when you were joking.
'No chance!' is a strong way to say no.
Well done, it means you agree.

tf.s: Manar loves walking around bookshops and clothes stores.
When you shop online, you can try clothes on before buying.
tf.why: In shops you can try things on; online you may have to send them back.

boxes.q: Reply: 'Let's swim in the sea!' (the water is very cold)
What does Rosie do if online clothes aren't big enough?
Complete: If I need something, I ask my parents to buy it ___.
What does Manar love walking around?
boxes.why: Manar loves bookshops and clothes stores.

boxes.q: Reply: 'It's too late to go shopping.' (you agree)
In a shop you can ___ clothes before you buy them.
boxes.why: Try on means put clothes on to check the size.

hunt.q: Rosie: shopping is a waste of ...

mcq.q: Do Rosie and Manar both like online shopping?
o: No, Rosie likes it but Manar prefers shops.
No, neither of them likes it.

mcq.q: Who thinks we may not need shops in the future?
What does Manar invite Rosie to do?
mcq.why: Manar invites Rosie to go shopping at the weekend.

mcq.q: Which expression means you are joking?
mcq.why: 'I'm only kidding!' shows you were joking.

mcq.q: A: 'Do you want to go to the mall now?' B is very tired. What does B say?
A: 'Are you ready for the test today?' B: 'Isn't it tomorrow?' A: '___ Yes, it is tomorrow.'
mcq.why: A was joking, so A says 'I'm only kidding!'

mcq.q: A: 'Shops are busy at the weekend.' B agrees. What does B say?
Why might Manar prefer shops to online shopping?
o: She can try things on and enjoys walking around shops.
She can't use the internet at all.
mcq.why: In shops you can try things on, and Manar loves walking around them.

mcq.q: What is one problem with online shopping in the dialogue?
o: Things might not fit, so you have to send them back.
You must stand in a long queue.
mcq.why: Rosie sends things back if they aren't big enough.

mcq.q: Rosie says shopping is a waste of time. What does this tell us?
o: She thinks online shopping is quicker.
She wants to go every day.
mcq.why: Rosie prefers online shopping because it saves time.
